protection_domains.cybersecurity: authenticated commands, secure updates, network isolation, credential/dependency protection
protection_domains.water_environment: immersion, ingress, corrosion, debris, silt, pressure and current; IP rating not established
protection_domains.fire_heat_power: battery isolation, BMS, thermal monitoring, overcurrent, emergency power isolation
protection_domains.communications: GPS denial, radio/network loss, stale telemetry, sensor failure, delayed commands
protection_domains.ai_data: person/animal detection uncertainty, depth/current estimation, conflicting sensors
protection_domains.mechanical: capsize, buoyancy, propulsion, wheel retraction, debris impact, rescue-load limits
protection_domains.human_mission: rescue capacity, passenger stability, emergency stop, safe abort and recovery

project_specific_hazards: 15 m flood-depth concept requires feasibility review
